metadata.title: Living Energy UI | Lived-experience renewable dashboard
metadata.description: A dashboard that shows how balcony solar and local renewables support everyday life—in terms you can feel, not just kWh.

worldPv.title: Balcony solar social implementation around the world
worldPv.subtitle: Tracking renter-friendly, no-construction renewables—from German law reform and Western legislation to off-grid rollouts in developing regions.

until2020.title: Pioneers and experiments
until2020.description: Plug-in panels were mostly hobby and pilot use. Safety rules and power caps stayed vague country by country.

from2021.title: Safety and cap debates accelerate
from2021.description: Demand for simple installs surged in places like Germany, pushing formal rules on output caps, certification, and grid connection.

from2023.title: Rental-friendly frameworks take shape
from2023.description: Germany and the EU led legal frameworks that make balcony solar easier for renters, often around the ~800W class.

present.title: Lived experience and no-construction become common language
present.description: Telling the story in everyday terms—not just kWh—and starting without specialist construction is now a shared global theme.

germanyEu.name: Germany & EU
germanyEu.headline: Plug-in renewables move toward a rental default
germanyEu.body: Reforms and guidance made simple balcony installs a realistic option. Clear wattage caps and lived-experience messaging are spreading together.

bullets.cap800w: Clearer framing around the ~800W output class
bullets.rentalHousing: Lower permission and install barriers for rental housing
bullets.livedExperience: Strong fit with appliance-style lived-experience messaging

unitedStates.name: United States
unitedStates.headline: Plug-in spreads amid state-by-state rules
unitedStates.body: Rules often sit with states and utilities rather than one federal path. Interest in balcony and deck setups paired with portable storage remains high.

bullets.stateRules: Diverse interconnection and safety rules by state and utility
bullets.rentalHousing: Growing install examples in rental and multifamily housing
bullets.livedExperience: Strong lived-experience framing tied to outage resilience

africaDeveloping.name: Africa & developing regions
africaDeveloping.headline: Balcony-scale renewables starting off-grid
africaDeveloping.body: Where the grid is thin or absent, small panels and batteries are daily infrastructure. Modular, no-construction kits are the baseline.

bullets.offGridFirst: Small-capacity kits aimed at off-grid and weak-grid use
bullets.rentalHousing: Rising plug-in demand in urban multifamily housing
bullets.livedExperience: Lighting, charging, and work hours drive adoption decisions
